articles.summary: DENVER and MIAMI, June 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Western Union Company (“Western Union”) (NYSE: WU) and International Money Express, Inc. (“Intermex”) (NASDAQ: IMXI) today provided an update on the approval process and timeline for Western Union’s pending acquisition of Intermex.
articles.title: Western Union and Intermex Provide an Update on Pending Acquisition of Intermex
